content_zh:
社区守卫告诉他，她一大早就出门，还没回来，于是他转到医院，在外头停好车，步向医院，正好看到她神色匆匆不知要去哪里。
「贝儿。」他喊她，她似乎没听见。
他大步跑向她，却听到她突然尖叫，顺着她的视线看去，一辆车朝她直冲过去，他第一个反应是直接跑过去推开她，旋即感觉车子从后头撞上自己，他飞了出去，落地时听见贝儿的尖叫声，然后，他就失去知觉了——
========================================================
如果他保护她，会要了他的命，那她宁愿一辈子都不要受到他的保护，甘愿由她一生一世守护他，当他一辈子的吉祥妹。
摸着掌尚勇的睑，保贝儿忍不住掉下泪。
「贝儿，你怎么又哭了？」
「尚勇，你醒了，要喝水吗？」
「嗯。」
拿水给他喝，她问：「要吃稀饭吗？」
「不要，我想出院，想吃你亲手做的寿司。」移动身子，他作势想下床。「躺了一个星期，没病也会躺出病来。」
「你身上的伤还没好，不要乱动。」她压住他，吓得他连动都不敢动一下，生怕一动，伤到她肚里的小宝宝。
轻摸她的肚子，他还是不敢相信他的孩子正窝在里面。「你还是回去休息，医院药水味那么重，你每天都在吐，我看了很不忍心。」
「不要！」她抓着他的手。「如果我走了，谁来保护你？那天就是我没拉着你的手，你才会被撞得躺在这里。」她很自责。
「贝儿，不是你的错，我反而庆幸被撞的人是我。」紧握她的手，他咧嘴笑，「你没听我二哥说，我这个人壮如牛，虽然一身伤，还好没性命危险，四肢也都健在，要换作别人，早一命呜呼了。」
掌尚勇真不敢想像若他没赶到，她一定套被撞上，说不定她就这样永远离开他。
不过肇事者——保俊的继母，自食恶果，在急救后宣告不治，对一个往生者，她生前的过错，他们都不愿再提。
现在只要她平安就好。
「你二哥真会说笑，不过那天你在急救中。他和你爸妈一起来，他可是比谁都紧张。」
掌尚勇笑了笑，兄弟嘛，吵闹归吵闹，感情好得很。

「贝儿，对不起，以后你做的早餐我一定吃，我也不会再乱吃……吃醋，气得不理你。」早在他醒来又知道她怀孕，他就老老实实全招了。
「尚勇，其实我……」低首，她赧颜一笑。「我也有误会你。」
「你误会我？什么事？」
「就是……你二嫂车子坏了，你出去帮她处理，我还以为她是你的『好朋友』。」他的家人每天都来，她一直没机会说，也怕他有脑震荡，担心说了他会生气，影响身体，看他今天的气色很好，她才放心说出口。
她把那天她看到的情形和心中的担忧坦白告诉他。
「这一切都怪我，如果不是我吃醋不理你，你也不会做那种联想。」他摸摸她的脸，吻了她一下。「那天二嫂自己开跑车出来，有两个小混混开车追她，她不小心撞到他们的车，那两个小混混居然要她陪他们去兜风才不追究撞车一事，她打电话给二哥，他那时正在洗澡没听到手机铃声，因为车子正好在公司附近，所以她才请我过去看看。」
保贝儿尴尬一笑。那天他在急救，她一看到他二嫂亲昵地搂着他二哥安慰他，她就知道自己误会大了。
「你就不知道我二嫂可是毒舌派掌门人，在等警察和我过去的时候，她一直狂骂那两个小混混，担心她气势要是弱下来说不定真的会被架走，一等到警察处理完，那两个小混混也走了，她居然全身发抖，我是在笑她也有怕的时候，之后我就叫她先到公司等二哥。」
原来——
「可是你二嫂很漂亮，说话也很温柔。」这一星期他二哥二嫂每天都来，她和她还成了好朋友。「我觉得很不好意思，原本他们要去佛罗伦斯，却因为你救我受伤，害得他们不能去了。」
「不用跟我二哥太客气，他去一趟希腊，旅游兼结婚，够了。」掌尚勇用还包裹着纱布的两只手，硬是将她圈住。
他的爸妈很开明，孩子在国外教堂结婚他们没意见，只要事后回台湾补办就行。
「大哥、二哥都已经在国外教堂结婚，不过他们还没在国内补办婚礼。」他的额头抵着她的。「等我伤好，我们就飞一趟义大利，选个你喜欢的教堂结婚，回台湾后，我们和大哥、二哥他们一起补办婚礼。」
她点头，完全臣服在他蓄满浓情的黑眸中。「可是，等你伤好，你二哥或许会带二嫂去佛罗伦斯……」
「别担心，总裁给他当，佛罗伦斯我们去。」
四目相接，彼此的浓情蜜意在眼波中交流，伤痕累累的他，身子每动一下就痛一下，不舍他痛，她主动捧住他的脸，献上为他狂热的亲吻。
「这算是特别病房的特别服务吗？」受宠若惊的他，挑眉一笑。
睨着他，她但笑不语。
「我喜欢。」
缓缓躺下，全身三分之二都包裹着纱布的掌尚勇，静静享受着她对他的「特别服务」一—呃，仅限热吻。

三个月后。
掌家豪宅今日热闹非凡，掌家三兄弟今日同时在台湾补办婚礼，最乐的要属大家长掌信和妻子夏水荷，看着媳妇肚子一个比一个大，两老笑得乐呵呵。
原先是想等媳妇们把孙子生下之后，再一起补办婚礼，但一个生完，另外两个接着生，加上坐月子，这一延宕，恐怕要延一年多，喜气都没了。
挑日子的先生说得好，带球进门喜上加喜，双喜临门，三兄弟加起来就是六喜，六喜临门，好事连连，谁能比得上。
为了这个盛大场面，婚礼设计公司早在一个月前就开始规画，体恤三位新娘子都有喜，走红毯时便让她们分别乘坐三辆白色马车，由新郎亲自驾马车，到红毯另一端前再由新郎扶新娘下车，并肩行九步，至替新人福证的牧师前，代表着长长久久。
当牧师念出——
「你愿意姿这个女人吗？爱她、忠诚于她，无论她贫困、患病或者残疾，直至死亡。」
「你愿意嫁这个男人吗？爱他、忠诚于他，无论他贫困、患病或者残疾，直至死亡。」
面对着穿着白妙大腹便便的艾飞儿，掌尚智深情地许下结婚誓言，「我愿意当守护飞儿公主一辈子的雷克斯。爱她，保护她。」
笑中带泪的艾飞儿，深情凝视着自己心爱的男人。「我愿意当尚智永远的莉妲公主，深爱他，守护他。」
已在希蜡结婚的左金，瞄了旁边也带球的小妻子夏春静一眼，低声笑道：「总裁大表哥八成是扮雷克斯扮上瘾了，连结婚也在说雷克斯，改天他说不定会跟人家去玩CoSplay，呵呵。」
夏春静奉上一个甜甜的笑容，手在左金大腿上狠狠担捏了下。「关你什么事？一点情趣都不懂的家伙。」
去了一趟希腊，她真觉得左金这人简直是个呆头鹅，要不是看在他很乖、很听话的份上，她老爸又很满意他，她才不嫁他咧！
第一对新人许下结婚誓言，紧接着第二对新人也彼此互许结婚誓言——
穿着白色西装的掌尚仁，挽着妻子巴瑞儿的手，一双桃花眼笑到眯起。
content_en:
The community guard told him that she had gone out early in the morning and had not returned yet, so he transferred to the hospital, parked the car outside, and walked towards the hospital. He happened to see her looking in a hurry and not knowing where she was going.
"Belle," he called her, but she didn't seem to hear him.
He strode towards her, but heard her suddenly scream. Following her line of sight, a car rushed towards her. His first reaction was to run over and push her away. Then he felt the car hit him from behind, and he flew out. When he landed, he heard Belle's scream, and then he lost consciousness——
========================================================
If he protects her, it will kill him, then she would rather not be protected by him for the rest of her life. She would rather protect him for the rest of her life and be his lucky sister for the rest of her life.
Touching Zhang Shangyong's eyelids, Bao Beier couldn't help but shed tears.
"Belle, why are you crying again?"
"Shang Yong, you're awake, do you want some water?"
"Yeah."
Giving him water to drink, she asked, "Would you like some porridge?"
"No, I want to be discharged from the hospital and eat the sushi you made." He moved his body and tried to get out of bed. "If you lie down for a week, you will get sick even if you are not sick."
"Your injuries haven't healed yet, don't move." She suppressed him, so scared that he didn't even dare to move, for fear that if he moved, he would hurt the baby in her belly.
Touching her belly gently, he still couldn't believe that his child was nestled inside. "You should go back and rest. The smell of medicine in the hospital is so strong and you are vomiting every day. I can't bear to see you."
"No!" She grabbed his hand. "If I leave, who will protect you? It was because I didn't hold your hand that day that you were hit and laid here." She blamed herself.
"Belle, it's not your fault. I'm glad that I was the one who got hit." Holding her hand tightly, he grinned, "You didn't listen to what my second brother said. I'm as strong as an ox. Although I'm injured, my life is not in danger and my limbs are still intact. If it had been anyone else, I would have died a long time ago."
Zhang Shangyong really couldn't imagine that if he hadn't arrived, she would have been hit, and maybe she would have left him forever.
However, the perpetrator, Baojun's stepmother, suffered the consequences and was declared dead after first aid. To a deceased person, they were unwilling to mention her mistakes during her lifetime.
As long as she is safe now.
"Your second brother is really good at joking, but you were in emergency that day. He came with your parents, and he was more nervous than anyone else."
Zhang Shangyong smiled, brothers, noisy is noisy, the relationship is very good.
"Belle, I'm sorry, I will definitely eat the breakfast you made from now on, and I won't eat it randomly again... I will be jealous and ignore you in anger." As early as he woke up and found out that she was pregnant, he had done all the tricks.
"Shang Yong, actually I..." She lowered her head and smiled. "I also misunderstood you."
"You misunderstood me? What happened?"
"It's just... your second sister-in-law's car broke down, and you went out to help her deal with it. I thought she was your 'good friend'." His family came here every day, but she never had a chance to tell her. She was also afraid that he would have a concussion, and she was worried that if she told him, he would be angry and affect his health. Seeing that he looked good today, she felt safe to say it.
She told him frankly what she had seen that day and her worries.
"It's all my fault. If I hadn't been jealous and ignored you, you wouldn't have made that association." He touched her face and kissed her. "That day, the second sister-in-law drove out in a sports car. Two gangsters chased her. She accidentally bumped into their car. The two gangsters actually asked her to go for a ride with them so as not to pursue the collision. She called the second brother. He was taking a shower at the time and didn't hear the ringing of his cell phone. Because the car happened to be near the company, she asked me to come over and have a look."
Bao Beier smiled awkwardly. He was doing first aid that day, and sheAs soon as she saw his second sister-in-law hugging his second brother affectionately to comfort him, she knew she had made a big misunderstanding.
"You don't know that my second sister-in-law is the head of the Vicious Tongue Sect. While she was waiting for the police and me to come over, she kept yelling at the two gangsters, worried that if her momentum weakened, she might really be kidnapped. Once the police finished dealing with it, the two gangsters also left, and she was actually shaking all over. I was laughing at her for being scared, and then I told her to go to the company to wait for my second brother."
It turns out——
"But your second sister-in-law is very beautiful and speaks very softly." His second brother and sister-in-law came every day this week, and she and she became good friends. "I feel very embarrassed. Originally, they were going to Florence, but because you were injured while saving me, they couldn't go."
"Don't be too polite to my second brother. He went to Greece to travel and get married. That's enough." Zhang Shangyong used his two hands still wrapped in gauze to trap her.
His parents are very liberal. They have no problem with their child getting married in a foreign church, as long as they return to Taiwan to make up for it afterwards.
"Both the eldest brother and the second brother have been married in overseas churches, but they haven't held a make-up wedding in China yet." He pressed his forehead against hers. "When I recover from my injury, we will fly to Italy and choose a church you like to get married. After we return to Taiwan, we will hold a make-up wedding with my eldest brother and second brother."
She nodded, completely surrendering to his passionate black eyes. "But, after you recover from your injury, your second brother may take his second sister-in-law to Florence..."
"Don't worry, let him be the president. Florence, let's go."
Their eyes met, each other's affection was exchanged in their eyes. He was scarred, and his body hurt every time he moved. Not wanting to leave him in pain, she took the initiative to hold his face and kissed him passionately.
"Is this a special service for a special ward?" He was flattered and raised his eyebrows with a smile.
Looking at him, she smiled and said nothing.
"I like it."
Slowly lying down, Zhang Shangyong, with two-thirds of his body wrapped in gauze, quietly enjoyed her "special service" for him—well, only passionate kisses.
Three months later.
The mansion of the headmaster was very lively today. The three brothers of the headmaster held a make-up wedding in Taiwan at the same time today. The happiest people were the headmaster Zhangxin and his wife Xia Shuihe. They laughed happily when they saw their daughter-in-law's belly getting bigger and bigger.
Originally, they wanted to wait for the daughters-in-law to give birth to their grandsons, and then hold a make-up wedding together, but after one child was born, the other two were born soon, plus the confinement period, so this delay would probably last more than a year, and the joy would be gone.
The man who picked the day said it well, scoring a goal with a ball brings double happiness, and the three brothers add up to six happiness, six happiness, good things come one after another, no one can compare with them.
For this grand occasion, the wedding design company started planning a month ago and was considerate of the happiness of the three brides. When walking down the red carpet, they let them ride in three white carriages. The groom drove the carriage himself. The groom helped the bride out of the car at the other end of the red carpet. They walked nine steps side by side to the priest who blessed the newlyweds, which symbolizes eternity.
When the pastor reads——
"Will you love this woman? Love her and be loyal to her, whether she is poor, sick or disabled, until death."
"Will you marry this man? Love him and be loyal to him, whether he is poor, sick or disabled, until death."
Facing the paunchy Avril in white clothes, Zhang Shangzhi made a wedding vow affectionately, "I am willing to be Rex who protects Princess Feier for the rest of my life. Love her and protect her."
Ai Feier, who was smiling with tears in her eyes, stared at her beloved man affectionately. "I am willing to be Shang Zhi's Princess Lida forever, love him deeply and protect him."
Zuo Jin, who was already married in Xixu, glanced at his young wife Xia Chunjing, who was also playing ball next to him, and laughed softly: "The president's eldest cousin is probably addicted to pretending to be Rex. He talks about Rex even when he gets married. Maybe he will go play CoS with me some other day.play, haha. "
Xia Chunjing gave Zuo Jin a sweet smile and squeezed Zuo Jin's thigh hard. "What does it have to do with you? You're a guy who doesn't know any sense of humor."
After a trip to Greece, she really felt that Zuo Jin was a fool. If it weren't for the fact that he was very good and obedient, and her father was very satisfied with him, she would not have married him!
The first couple made a wedding vow, and then the second couple also made a wedding vow to each other——
Zhang Shangren, who was wearing a white suit, held the hand of his wife, Barrier, and smiled until his peach blossom eyes narrowed.
